workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: One account can belong to multiple workspaces. Switching moves company profiles, target buyers and leads to that workspace.
workspaces.currentDesc: This is the workspace you are using now. Renaming only changes the display name.
workspaces.name: Workspace name
workspaces.leaveHint: You need a new invitation to rejoin after leaving. The last member or last admin cannot leave.
workspaces.createDesc: You become its admin and switch to it immediately.

notifications.runPartialMessage: Some leads are ready — start reviewing them now.
notifications.runFailedMessage: Open the run to see where it stopped and decide the next step.
notifications.leadQualifiedMessage: A new qualified buyer lead is ready for review.
notifications.claimRejectedMessage: One company fact was set aside.

brand.loginDesc: GainOS proactively finds overseas buyers, judges fit and timing, and hands you leads you can actually act on.
brand.registerDesc: Build your company profile, define your target buyers, and let GainOS discover, qualify and deliver.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your workspace and keep this week's growth moving.
login.terms: By continuing you agree to GainOS's terms of service and data compliance policy.
login.errPasswordShort: Password must be at least 10 characters

register.title: Create a workspace
register.subtitle: One minute to open a growth workspace for your company.
register.inviteSubtitle: Set your password to join the team workspace.
register.companyPlaceholder: e.g. Ningbo Hongda Machinery Co., Ltd.
register.errCompanyRequired: Enter your company name (at least 2 characters)
register.errPassword: Password must be 10+ characters with letters and digits
register.errFailed: Something went wrong, please try again

workspace.title: {greeting}, let's move growth forward today.
workspace.nextEngineDesc: This is a one-time deployment setting (JWKS trust and role mapping), unrelated to your account. The page turns green once it's done; meanwhile you can invite your teammates.
workspace.nextFirstDesc: Add your website and name — GainOS will understand your products and capabilities automatically. This is where buyer discovery starts.
workspace.nextReadyDesc: Target buyers arrive with M3. For now, invite colleagues to work together.
workspace.enginePendingDesc: A one-time deployment setting, unrelated to your account. This card turns green automatically once done.
workspace.teamEmpty: Just you so far — invite your colleagues
workspace.summaryNoIcp: Your company profile is ready — next, set up target buyers
workspace.summaryEmpty: Create a company profile first so GainOS can start finding buyers
workspace.kpiRunEmptyHint: Generate a plan to start sourcing
workspace.notificationsEmpty: No notifications yet. New sourcing progress and leads will appear here.
workspace.recentLeadsEmpty: No leads yet. Once sourcing starts, promising companies will show up here.
workspace.nextFactsDesc: Only facts you approve are used to design target buyers. {count} facts are waiting.
workspace.nextFactsNoneDesc: Add a fact manually, or come back after the website has been understood.
workspace.nextIcpDesc: Tell GainOS your target markets, buyer personas and qualification rules.
workspace.nextActivateDesc: The draft must be active before sourcing; activate it once it looks right.
workspace.nextPlanDesc: AI will draft search conditions for your target buyer; nothing runs until you confirm.
workspace.nextConfirmDesc: The plan is ready — confirm it to start sourcing.
workspace.nextRunDesc: The plan is confirmed. Start the run and GainOS will look for matching companies.
workspace.nextRunRunningDesc: You can step away — progress updates automatically.
workspace.nextRunFailedDesc: Check the run details for the failure reason, then try again.
workspace.nextRunPartialDesc: Some sources did not finish. Review the leads produced so far or open the run details.
workspace.nextNoLeadsDesc: Open the run details, or adjust target buyers and try again.
workspace.nextJudgeDesc: {count} leads are waiting for your decision.
workspace.nextLeadDesc: {count} leads are worth a closer look.
workspace.nextReportDesc: Record follow-up outcomes to help GainOS learn.
workspace.nextDoneDesc: We'll let you know when new leads or sourcing progress arrive.

companies.title: Company profile
companies.subtitle: Your company and product facts — the shared foundation for every growth module. Add your website and GainOS learns the rest.
companies.errorWhy: A one-time deployment setting, unrelated to your account. This page recovers automatically once it's done; nothing you entered is lost.
companies.emptyDesc: Add your website to create the first profile — the starting point for target buyers and sourcing.
companies.wizardHint: Website and name are enough. GainOS learns products, capabilities and brand from your site and keeps enriching — a failed enrichment never blocks manual completion.
companies.name: Company name
companies.namePlaceholder: Optional — domain is used until enrichment fills it in
companies.factsHint: GainOS extracted these facts from your website. Only facts you approve are used to design target buyers; leave uncertain ones unapproved.
companies.offeringsEmpty: Products and services extracted from your website will appear here after enrichment.
companies.manualHint: When automatic enrichment is unavailable, add a fact manually; it still needs approval before use.
companies.manualStatementHint: e.g. The company is IATF 16949 certified (renewed 2025)
companies.manualEvidenceHint: Certificate number, internal document name or source URL
companies.manualCreated: Fact added — it is waiting for approval.
companies.conflictsHint: These facts contradict each other. Keep one; the other is revoked and no longer used for target buyers.
companies.conflictConfirm: Keep this fact and revoke the other one?
companies.revokeConfirm: Revoke this approved fact? Downstream will stop using it.
companies.claimsEmptyApproved: No approved facts yet. Approve at least one to design a target buyer.
companies.claimsNoMatch: No matching facts. Try another keyword.
companies.claimsPartialFail: {count} facts could not be processed. The list was refreshed — please retry.
companies.approvedReady: {count} approved facts — ready to design target buyers.
companies.approvedNeed: Approve at least one fact to design target buyers.

findBuyers.title: Find buyers
findBuyers.subtitle: Define your target buyer profile and let GainOS discover overseas companies by market and product — with fit, need and reachability judged before delivery.
findBuyers.step1Empty: No company profile yet — it's the prerequisite for defining target buyers.
findBuyers.step2Desc: Industry, countries, size, exclusions and buyer roles — set once, reused every run.
findBuyers.step3Desc: Starts right after confirmation, typically 20–60 minutes; progress and failures are shown honestly.
findBuyers.listDesc: AI drafts from the approved facts in your company profile; edit freely before activating.
findBuyers.activeHint: Active: {name} (one active target-buyer set per profile)
findBuyers.emptyDesc: Pick a company profile and let GainOS draft one; review the rules and activate before generating a sourcing plan.
findBuyers.createDesc: Draft from your company profile, then edit rules, backtest and activate.
findBuyers.noCompanies: No company profile yet — create one first.
findBuyers.factsCheckFailed: Could not confirm this company's facts. Please retry.
findBuyers.noApprovedFacts: No approved facts for this company yet. Open Company profile, approve at least one fact, then come back to generate the draft.
findBuyers.allCompaniesHaveIcp: Every company profile already has a target-buyer draft. Open and adjust the existing one instead.
findBuyers.approvedFactsCount: {count} approved facts available for designing target buyers.
findBuyers.createNote: Generation consumes one execution budget authorization; if the model is unavailable we say so and never save a half-draft.
findBuyers.detailHint: Draft generated from approved company facts. It is used for sourcing only after activation — adjust anything that doesn't match your judgement.
findBuyers.rulesDesc: A deterministic, auditable rules engine; only a failed Must-have excludes a company.
findBuyers.ruleValueHint: Text; use JSON for arrays/numbers, e.g. ["automotive"] or 100
findBuyers.noRules: No rules yet; the AI draft usually brings a few — add more here.
findBuyers.backtestDesc: Validate the rules against known customers/non-customers; the score is deterministic and repeatable.
findBuyers.backtestHint: Provide an array of objects with name, attributes and expected (match or exclude).
findBuyers.plansDesc: An AI plan must be confirmed by a human before it can run.
findBuyers.runStarted: Sourcing has started — reopen this run anytime to check progress.
findBuyers.runLinkMissing: Sourcing has started, but the local run record is missing (it may predate run-link tracking). Open it from notifications or ask an admin to backfill it.
findBuyers.planCreated: Sourcing plan generated — confirm it to start
findBuyers.name: Name
findBuyers.attributesHint: Enter company attributes as key-value pairs; leave unknown attributes out.
findBuyers.attributesInvalid: Company attributes must be a valid JSON object

leads.title: Buyer leads
leads.subtitle: Every lead carries evidence, reasoning and reachability — your decisions make the next round sharper.
leads.queueReviewDesc: Default queue: new leads waiting for your call
leads.queueQualifiedDesc: Confirmed, with a downloadable lead package
leads.queueRejectedDesc: Reasons recorded to improve the next round
leads.queueSanctionsDesc: Sanctions match — admin review required before follow-up
leads.noIcpDesc: Approve facts in the company profile, then define and activate target buyers. Leads appear here after a sourcing run.
leads.sanctionsHoldCount: {count} leads have a sanctions match and are waiting for admin compliance review.
leads.emptyDesc: Leads enter the queue when a sourcing run finishes under Find buyers. Start with a company profile and target buyers.
leads.contactPathNote: For your own outreach — we never send on your behalf.
leads.sanctionsAdminHint: A sanctions match needs admin review. A false positive returns to the queue; a confirmed hit stays isolated and is never delivered.
leads.sanctionsClearConfirm: Confirm this is a false positive and restore the lead to the review queue?
leads.sanctionsConfirmConfirm: Confirm this lead is a real sanctions hit? This cannot be undone through this entry point.
leads.sanctionsCleared: Marked as a false positive; the lead is back in the review queue.
leads.sanctionsConfirmed: Confirmed sanctions hit; the lead remains isolated.
leads.acceptDesc: Your decisions and feedback improve future recommendations.
leads.rejectDesc: Choose a reason; it is recorded and used to improve the next round.
leads.outreachDraftDesc: Generated for review and copy only — never sent automatically.
leads.outreachNeedsQualified: Accept this lead before drafting first outreach.
leads.outreachReady: Draft generated — review or copy it below.

contacts.title: Decision makers
contacts.subtitle: Named contacts are personal data. RISKY or inferred e-mails are not guaranteed; verify before sending.
contacts.emptyDesc: Discovery shows name, title, department and contact points, with source links and evidence timestamps.
contacts.scopeHint: Decision-maker data needs the engine's personal-data:read grant. Until it is enabled the card stays read-only; ask operations to confirm the engine release and grant.
contacts.missingEmail: {count} decision makers still have no e-mail. Use “Guess e-mails” to infer and verify from the company e-mail pattern.
contacts.discoverDesc: The engine looks through the website, registries, trade fairs and social sources for named contacts. This can take several minutes and consumes execution budget.
contacts.guessDesc: Infers e-mail addresses from the company pattern and runs an SMTP handshake for decision makers without one. Inferred results may stay unconfirmed and consume execution budget.
contacts.verifyDesc: Runs one SMTP handshake against {email}; the result is written back to the contact point.
contacts.riskyWarning: This e-mail is RISKY or inferred; verification may still not confirm it.
contacts.acknowledge: I understand this e-mail is uncertain and still want to verify it
contacts.noBasis: Discovering or probing named contacts requires an explicit lawful basis; without one the engine refuses before writing any data.

basisHint.legitimate_interest: For B2B outreach: requires a completed LIA; put its reference into “Basis reference”.
basisHint.consent: Only when the person has explicitly consented; cite the consent record.
basisHint.contract: Contact is necessary to perform an existing contract; cite the contract.
basisHint.legal_obligation: Contact or verification is legally required; cite the statute or ticket.

contacts.discoverDone: Discovery finished; {count} decision makers are now available.
contacts.guessDone: E-mail guessing finished: {attempted} attempted, {persisted} stored, {verified} verified.
contacts.verifyBlocked: Verification was blocked by the compliance gate (BLOCKED); no probe was sent.

reports.title: Weekly report
reports.subtitle: One report a week: what was judged, what's worth pursuing, what compliance blocked — plus your real feedback.
reports.card1Desc: Judged · Pursuing · Blocked — reported honestly, no polish
reports.card2Desc: Row-level data with export decisions and compliance columns
reports.card3Desc: Fill the five customer columns online; results write straight back to the engine
reports.emptyTitle: Your first report appears after the first sourcing run
reports.emptyDesc: Unfinished weeks produce no empty report; a week with no qualified buyers is a real result and will say so.
reports.noData: No leads to export for this week
reports.uploadDesc: Fill the five columns in the exported CSV and upload it unchanged; rows match by lead ID and only append outcomes.
reports.noIcpDesc: The weekly report groups accepted leads by target buyer; set and activate one first.
reports.onlineDesc: Accepted leads for this ICP, approximated to the selected ISO week by last update time; the exported CSV is the precise weekly record. Feedback is append-only.
reports.onlineEmpty: No accepted leads in the selected week (or all beyond the first 100)

members.title: Members & roles
members.subtitle: Admins approve and export; members handle profiling and lead judging day to day.
members.tipSentHead: Invitation created and valid for 7 days. Share this link with your colleague to join:
members.confirmRemove: Remove this member? They lose access to this workspace immediately.

runs.title: Sourcing run
runs.subtitle: See which companies this run found, how many matched, and what to do next.
runs.runStatusHint: We'll notify you when it finishes — you don't need to keep this page open.

userStage.searchHint: Search candidate companies by target and market
userStage.collectHint: Deduplicate, verify and exclude suppressed companies
userStage.matchHint: Judge product, role and buying signals
userStage.enrichHint: Add website, signals and change evidence

runs.failureHint: This is not the end. Review the leads already produced, or adjust the target buyers and generate a new plan.
runs.partialDesc: Some results are ready — review the existing leads now, or adjust the target buyers and generate a new sourcing plan.
runs.failedDesc: The run stopped after finding {count} companies. Check the failure below, adjust the target buyers, then generate a new plan.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Your own login, membership, and workspace actions in this workspace. To prevent cross-tenant leakage only your records are shown; platform operations are audited in the ops console.

privacy.title: Data & privacy
privacy.subtitle: Submit GDPR Art.17 erasure / Art.21 objection requests. The engine runs them asynchronously and returns count-only receipts.
privacy.rightAccess: Access & export: delivered leads via the weekly CSV
privacy.rightErasure: Erasure: delete personal data for a company or contact
privacy.rightObjection: Objection: stop processing and add a legal suppression
privacy.rightResponse: Receipts: status and counts, never personal data
privacy.scopeNote: A deletion request first freezes and records a legal suppression, then erases asynchronously; the subject is never re-ingested or contacted.
privacy.formDesc: Provide the engine subject id (company or contact UUID). Requests run asynchronously; track status below.
privacy.subjectIdHint: Engine UUID of the company or contact
privacy.requestRefHint: Ticket / LIA / contract reference (audit only, no personal data)
privacy.asyncNote: Returns 202 with a request id immediately; do not resubmit before it completes.
privacy.submitted: Accepted {id}; refresh later to check status
privacy.invalidId: Subject ID is not a UUID
privacy.invalidIdHint: Copy the UUID from the company or contact details
privacy.noTracked: No deletion requests yet. Request ids live only in this browser, so keep them safe.
privacy.subject: Subject
privacy.trackedNote: Receipts contain counts only. Clearing this browser's local list does not affect the server.
